title: Singing Saba-chan
steps: Turn on Singing Saba-chan. You can also set the player panel and volume levelling here.
Pick a channel for music and choose Singing Saba-chan under Saba-chan jobs. Only the player stays there; regular messages are deleted.
Join a voice channel, then type a song name or link in the Singing Saba-chan channel. Saba-chan joins and plays it.
